title: Compile both mixed-rank suppliers with polynomial productive width
body:
This construction compiles the selected and pending mixed-rank suppliers into independent full-rank outputs using at most **`N^16` productive fields** at terminal rank `N`. It bounds all pre-cover instruction and bank occurrences by **`O_source(N^51)`**. Both complete multiplication prices survive. The new proof supplies the raw-word-to-uniform-program implication for the four named suppliers without using a Pascal flow. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5/research/single-grade-rank-compiler/PROOF.md) · [Physical application](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5/research/single-grade-rank-compiler/APPLICATION.md) · [Exact types and dimensions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5/research/single-grade-rank-compiler/RESULT.json)

| Complete caller | Ordinary BIT delivered | Conditional multiplication κ |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Selected shared native | 0.00385248 | 0.00363005817 |
| Pending four-return P104 | 0.003879927836145 | 0.00387944011068 |

A chronological product has independent target slots of several ranks. The compiler keeps one rank, supplies owned zeros for the other slots, and pays every native request. Its sharp criterion compares the log target moment against the chord between the two endpoint log paid moments at every intervening price. For the four actual profiles, paid ranks are at most `8^v` and the retained rank is at least `16^v`. A child reuses surrounding axes in the original tensor and restores them before return. Root tiles complete each independent field. The binary compiler finishes the rational identity projector on the whole root before applying its cover. Its ordinary service starts from elementary digit swaps. The gain concerns the algorithm and its proof. The pending complex sufficient `log2 N` rises from 15,171,300,000,000,000,000 to **223,634,496,475,974,210,983,125,057,536**. The binary cover still pays its full general linear group, weight routes, storage and cleanup. The alternative proof retains the all-column native primitives, owned erasure, physical precision and movement, and analytic recovery. The selected record and its five named assumptions are intact. The terminal programs have constructive descriptions. No end-to-end run of an astronomical program, independent human acceptance, or proof-kernel verification is claimed. ### Verification

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/single-grade-rank-compiler
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/single-grade-rank-compiler outcome=completed
```

Eight registered commands passed in the committed checkout and in a read-only, Git-free export of the same 31 files. Each complete caller passed 54 strict and four functional checks, with minimum margin `10^-15`. New precision-depth guards need 99 and 109 bits in their respective witness comparisons. The independent checks exercised 618,408 elementary payload cells, 7,776 weighted labels, and source-specific odd-grid failures. The proof covers arbitrary inputs and positive column counts. Finite executions test the implementation and its failure cases. Cold native admissions, unrelated historical suites and a physical multiplier benchmark were outside this replay. [Verification scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5/research/single-grade-rank-compiler/VALIDATION.md) · [Replay manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5/research/single-grade-rank-compiler/VERIFY.json) · [Caller gates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5/research/single-grade-rank-compiler/check_callers.py) · [Cover checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/03b572b3b9ab72c6ba67762e85e1630cda1daad5/research/single-grade-rank-compiler/check_cover.py)

The navigation test expects `make frontier7000-verify` and the base CI guide still names [result #6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030). I reproduced that failure on the canonical base. GitHub skipped the package replay. The eight local and export results above come from separate runs.
